correctness.rationale: The odd-prime group theorem and all displayed counts check. The central-shift rule follows by taking a central second argument; if the image of a central generator has nonzero quotient coordinate, a nontrivial commutator with a chosen h forces j times that coordinate to vanish for nonzero j in F_p, a contradiction. The projection to the now well-defined quotient is additive and hence F_p-linear. The antisymmetric part of the central cocycle equation gives det A=k(1+tr A); its remaining symmetric part is the polarization of −k ω(Av,v)/2, giving the unique affine-in-central-coordinate formula and the converse by substitution. Conjugations by (Av,0) verify the brace law, and the nondegenerate pairing separates labelled operations. A group automorphism has quotient P, multiplies the center by det P by the commutator identity, and its remaining coordinate correction is linear after subtracting that action. Transport of the brace law gives PAP⁻¹, proving the isomorphism assertion, not an assertion about all braces of order p³. For trace t and determinant d, counting bc=a(t−a)−d gives p(p+χ(t²−4d)); on t=−1 only d=0 lifts, and that slice has p(p+1) matrices and p³ lifts per matrix. Of the p−1 excluded determinants on that trace, each gives one similarity class except 1/4, which gives two; the count of all classes is p²+p. Bijectivity of the column-triangular map and of its dual is decided by their quotient determinant and center scalar. Off t=−1 the two singularity conditions are respectively k=0 and k=−1 and cannot coincide. On t=−1 both maps are singular. Either one-bijective count is the sum of p² times M_p(t,0) over t≠−1, with t=0 the unique zero-discriminant case; it gives p⁵−2p³. Subtract both singles and the neither count from the total to obtain p⁶−3p⁵+4p³ and the asymptotic proportion. This is an all-odd-prime analytic check; verify.py was inspected but not run, and finite checks cannot prove completeness of the parametrization.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Existence of the operations and the structure of nonempty fibers are not new separately; the precise obstruction locus follows by projecting the known group classification. The general cohomology theorem alone would not give that locus without computation.

evidence: Savelyev's parameters already make the fiber cardinality the number of solutions of one scalar linear equation times p²; the trace −1 case isolates the ordinary similarity orbit of diag(0,−1) if the determinant is zero.

By the published dual parameter change, off trace −1 the two nonbijectivity conditions are k=0 and k=−1, hence mutually exclusive. On trace −1 both hold and every admissible A has eigenvalues 0,−1. There are |GL₂(F_p)|/(p−1)²=p(p+1) such A with p³ choices of central parameters each, so the neither cell is p⁵+p⁴. The published total and marginal now give all three other cells by inclusion–exclusion; the limit follows directly.

Transport of the brace lambda map reduces the remaining isomorphism statement to ordinary matrix similarity. Within trace −1 the already determined obstruction simply deletes determinant zero; the repeated-root pair at determinant 1/4 has the standard two classes.

Explicit transfer: the linear map R(v,z)=(Av,kz+ℓ(v)) goes to B(v,z)=(Av,kz+ℓ(v)−kω(Av,v)/2). Both parametrizations are exhaustive and unique. This correction along the center preserves invertibility, since both maps have the same invertible-block criterion. Substitution of the group inverse shows that the group dual corresponds to −I−R.
Savelyev's quotient matrix in group coordinates gives l_alpha m_beta−l_beta m_alpha=k(1+l_alpha+m_beta), with two free central parameters, and the same dual action on the quotient and center.

The remaining table and lift counts are obtained by elementary refinement of those exact results; there is no evidence that the group totals recover novelty by changing operator categories. value.rationale: Liftability and joint invertibility are natural questions, and the coordinate proof is useful exposition. But for the advertised finding the exact total and one-operator marginal are already available through a bijection, the joint census adds an elementary inclusion–exclusion using a single standard diagonal orbit, and the fiber/type split is a direct projection of the prior scalar constraint followed by the routine 2×2 similarity list. No separate structural or exact-invariant advance that clears the value bar is established merely by bundling these consequences. The frozen result is left unchanged; no repaired claim is asserted.
